title: Capture and render API (UE client -> maximall-web)
description: POST {BackendURL}/api/render, multipart/form-data with parts: beauty (PNG 8-bit sRGB, WxH), depth (PNG 16-bit grayscale, same WxH, value = min(sceneDepthCm, 65535) i.e. 1 unit = 1 cm, 65535 = sky/far), mask (PNG 8-bit grayscale, same WxH, 255 = product pixels from the ShowOnlyActors capture of this instance's planner booths, 0 elsewhere), meta (application/json, below). The backend composites the ORIGINAL beauty pixels back where final mask = (mask>127) AND (|depth - productDepth| < 3 cm), productDepth being the depth rendered in the ShowOnlyActors pass (optional part `maskDepth`, 16-bit). Response 202 {renderId}. Progress goes out on Socket.io ai.render to the session. Files served at GET /api/render/:renderId/{beauty,preview,final}.png.

boothId.description: v2.2: salon booth actor name when preset = booth

x-ar-upload: POST /api/ar/upload must accept exactly what UARExportSubsystem.cpp (ARExport/ARExportSubsystem.cpp:431) sends; backend role reads that code and implements it; response contract = whatever that code parses.
